'''Mu group''' was a [[Flight group/Legends|flight group]] of [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[TIE pilot|pilots]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that took part in the [[Battle for Honor]], a campaign against the traitorous [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]], who defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The unit included the ace pilot and [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]], [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]]. Pilots of Mu group flew [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] initially, when [[Raid near DS 5|raiding]] and [[Attack on the DS 5 convoy|destroying]] his supply convoys. However, once that was finished, the group later switched to [[TIE/ad starfighter]]s, to [[Battle at DS 5|face off]] against Harkov's fighters. They successfully gave [[Admiral Harkov's fleet]] large casualties.
